cases.purpose: Authenticate against an initial hash, pause at the new-password PTY prompt, allow a cooperating lock or set, then require the older change to fail without altering the winning update; also verify ordinary successful change.
cases.oracle: Deterministic PTY prompt barrier and independently verified Argon2/OpenSSL hash; concurrent winner must survive unchanged. The helper executes only inside the guarded disposable guest.
cases.comparison: Exact success/failure classes, byte-exact winning shadow records, and OpenSSL KDF verification of the uncontended new PHC.
cases.setup_script:
[[ $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r v </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
IFS= read -r u </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
[[ $v == QEMU && $u =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
set -e
/usr/bin/mkdir seed lock
old=$(printf %s old-secret-r3 | /usr/bin/argon2 w5saltw5salt1234 -id -t 1 -k 1024 -p 1 -l 32 -e)
printf "alice:%s:19000:0:99999:7:::\n" "$old" > seed/shadow
/usr/bin/cp seed/shadow db/shadow
/usr/bin/chmod 600 seed/shadow db/shadow
/usr/bin/python3 -I /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/runtime06-phc-oracle-r3.py seed/shadow alice pw.old > "$HOME/setup-oracle.txt"

[[ $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125

export PHCLIB_PASSWD=$PWD/db/passwd PHCLIB_GROUP=$PWD/db/group PHCLIB_SHADOW=$PWD/db/shadow BPW_LOCK_DIR=$PWD/lock BASHPASSWD_KERNEL_SECRETS=0 PHCLIB_M=1024 PHCLIB_T=1 PHCLIB_P=1
/usr/bin/python3 -I /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/runtime06-auth-race-r3.py "$BASH"

cases.purpose: Create an account with an existing primary group, then verify canonical unpadded Base64 Argon2id and the derived key independently.
cases.oracle: Independent OpenSSL ARGON2ID with binary-safe hex salt and a known-answer self-check, canonical Base64 round-trip and 16-byte salt/32-byte digest.
cases.comparison: Require successful add, a single existing group, no new same-name group, correct account and independent KDF match.
cases.script:
[[ $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r v </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
IFS= read -r u </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
[[ $v == QEMU && $u =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
export PHCLIB_PASSWD=$PWD/db/passwd PHCLIB_GROUP=$PWD/db/group PHCLIB_SHADOW=$PWD/db/shadow BASHPASSWD_KERNEL_SECRETS=0 PHCLIB_M=1024 PHCLIB_T=1 PHCLIB_P=1
/usr/bin/chmod 600 db/shadow || exit 125
passwd add-fd erin 3 -u 2001 -g 100 3< pw > "$HOME/add.out" 2> "$HOME/add.err" || exit 1
/usr/bin/grep -Eq "^erin:x:2001:100:" db/passwd || exit 2
! /usr/bin/grep -q "^erin:" db/group || exit 3
[[ $(/usr/bin/grep -c "^users:.*:100:" db/group) == 1 ]] || exit 4
/usr/bin/python3 -I /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/runtime06-phc-oracle-r3.py db/shadow erin pw || exit 5
printf "account=created-existing-group\n"
